References 2 and 3 lock the NORTHWEST BACK THREE-QUARTER camera and anatomical scale; do not reproduce their two-column layout or any existing pose.

Face and travel diagonally AWAY toward screen UP-LEFT. Show the rounded brown back of the head, high ponytail with pale green ribbons, left ear and narrow cheek edge only: no visible eye, smile, forehead emblem or front face. Tiny stocky body, wooden beads across the nape, ochre cloud-trim back robe, ivory sleeves and short puffy trousers, green braided belt, brown/gold boots with green ankle ties. Anatomical LEFT shield and its single gold shoulder pauldron stay screen LEFT, the NEAR side. Anatomical RIGHT hand holds the upright ring-headed staff screen RIGHT, the FAR side. Pose NW16: three quarters from NW13 toward NW01, the final distinct airborne reach before the cycle closes. Extend the near screen-left SHIELD-SIDE LEFT lower leg forward/up-left toward the footprint of the LEFT figure NW01 in reference 2. Its boot is very low but remains just above contact, heel slightly lower than toe and sole almost facing down. The far screen-right STAFF-SIDE RIGHT boot still bears the weight and trails relative to that approaching step. Keep the near moving thigh in front at the overlap; the stride is more open than NW15, without shifting the whole character. Do not plant the near boot yet or duplicate NW01. Preserve enough small knee flexion and heel clearance to make the 16-to-01 landing visibly continuous. Exactly two solid legs and boots.

Keep the reference head-to-body ratio, body volume and camera distance. Full standing-equivalent silhouette fills about 88-90% of the square height, with at least 5% clear margin on every edge. Keep hair, ribbons, staff tip, shield and tassels fully inside; staff tip and tassels stay above the planted-foot baseline. Only slight natural gait bob and attached cloth motion, no whole-body travel or per-pose zoom. Intended processing uses the same 0.84 whole-cell common scale as the preserved NW anchors; do not shrink the character or imitate the small reference pixel grid.

Request native 2048x2048 at highest available native visual fidelity, crisp clean hand-painted hair strands, back-robe trim, braided cords, boot edges and metal carving. Actual native single-person cell must be at least 1024 pixels on both axes and will be checked separately. Draw new detail; no upscaling, collage, copied pose, mirrored pose, pixel art or sharpening halo.

Background truly transparent RGBA. Opaque subject, clean natural antialiasing, no magenta or colored fringe. No ground or shadow, detached effects, ghost boots, extra limbs, duplicate outlines, transparency through clothing, checkerboard, labels, border, divider or watermark.
